## Revenue Growth Rate Analysis

### Executive Summary
Revenue grew from **100** (January 2025) to **170** (June 2025), representing a **+70.00% growth rate** over the 6-month period.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|

| First Month Revenue | 100 |
| Last Month | 2025-06 |
| Last Month Revenue | 170 |

$$\text{Growth Rate} = \frac{\text{Revenue}_{\text{last}} - \text{Revenue}_{\text{first}}}{\text{Revenue}_{\text{first}}} \times 100 = \frac{170 - 100}{100} \times 100 = \textbf{70.00\%}$$

---

### Conclusion
From January 2025 to June 2025, monthly revenue increased by **70.00%** (from 100 to 170), reflecting a consistent and strong upward trend across all 6 months.
